messages:
miriam: Heads-up — staging canary failed during deploy window. Deploy-bot reported artifact checksum mismatch on mirror pull :grimacing:

deploy-bot: [automated] deploy failed: 409 BlobMountFailure for key `models/prod/v1.2.3.tar.gz` (checksum mismatch). Attempted mirrors: mirror-eu-1, mirror-us-2

sam: @miriam can you paste the deploy-bot log link? do we have last-good digest?

miriam: https://deploy-logs/redwood/1744650000 — tail:
```
ERROR: checksum mismatch expected=sha256:abc123 got=sha256:ffef45
HTTP 409 BlobMountFailure
```

tariq: Mirror reupload started — re-pushing artifact to mirror-eu-1 now, keeping original in GCS. If reupload succeeds we can manual-promote.

lena: Checking cache metadata on CDN, possible stale index. Running `cache-invalidate --prefix models/prod/v1.2.3` now :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dena: Suggest hold release window until reupload + verify. If reupload fails we should pin to v1.2.2 and promote that image instead to avoid rollback later.

jaime: Agree with hold. If we pin, we need to update release notes + rollback docs. Who can prepare the pin PR? @sam?

sam: I can do PR to pin and trigger manual promote if reupload doesn't finish by +30m. will also add a note in release channel.

miriam: reupload succeeded on mirror-eu-1, digest now sha256:abc123 (matches origin). Deploy-bot retry queued.

deploy-bot: [automated] retry trigger accepted, starting artifact pull on canary nodes.

tariq: Canary now green on 3/3 nodes. Observability shows token latency stable. Manual promote recommended.

jaime: OK to promote. Sam, please proceed with release notes update and create the promote with deploybot flag `--force-manual`.

sam: done — PR merged and promote started. deploybot status: 1/3 promoted -> 3/3 complete.

miriam: Release window resumed. Adding postmortem note: root cause appears to be mirror index staleness + transient multipart upload race. Create ticket to harden mirror integrity checks.

dena: created ticket INT-4578 and assigned to infra. Thanks all :tada:
